module: Vue wizard to choose level/vehicle/options for freeroam mode, "level grid" root version. The hooks call freeroam_freeroamConfigurator.onWizard*. Children: level (detail, minor sub-route), vehicles (> vehicle, options > multiplayer).
notes: Route configuration module: it exports no function. routeManager reads it (via the ui_router_routes_<name> extension) when routes.lua includes it with `{ include = "<name>" }`.
The keys of `Children` form the segments of the dotted name: "<module>.<child>". `children` (lowercase) in a node designates its sub-routes; `include` mounts another module there.
`ui` is inherited by child routes (uiTypes, uiTypesFilter, infoBar, topBar, uiApps, uiNav, triggerPause): a child redefines it only for what changes.
`isMinorRoute = true` marks detail sub-routes (they do not count as a main step, inferred from the name).

Root.desc: {screenId = "freeroamLevels", title = "ui.menu.freeroamSelector.wizard.location", onEnter onWizardLevelsRouteEnter, onMount onWizardLevelsRouteMount, scopeTree root > (grid, auxillary), targetScope grid, ui Vue, default infoBar, uiApps hidden}

Children.desc: level (dynamic title via resolveSelectedLevelTitle), vehicles (> vehicle with dynamic title resolveSelectedVehicleTitle, > options > multiplayer).

ModuleName.desc: Name of the routes module (first segment of the dotted name).
